proofs contains current-cut acceptance evidence only. candidateProofs points to related test source files; this ledger did not execute them and does not claim they pass.

Statuses are verified only with a current production path and acceptance proof; partial means code exists with integration or acceptance gaps; pending and blocked rows include their concrete reason; excluded rows retain the owner disposition.

The checked-in producer status is based on an older producer revision. The requested new969 preflight result and a real producer artifact were not available in this evidence cut, so S01-S05 are unverified here rather than asserted missing.
Source and target paths remain unchanged; mapping or file relocation alone does not establish completion.
No production infrastructure, legacy PVC, unpublished data, release, package, or external service was changed.

The mandated frozen install failed because the checked-in lock lacks apps/build-worker and plugins/buildkit workspace entries. The root check passed with the isolated pnpm 11 wrapper after pnpm locally refreshed those entries; the lock diff was restored. The source-handler/preflight mapping harness passed 9 tests, but it does not establish real producer/runtime acceptance (details in task-status.json).

Per-user ownership/ACL is excluded by X03: numeric GitHub repository identity is the instance binding and user identity is only a fresh authorization actor/audit value; no duplicate user-instance ACL is retained in the new API. Actions/template sync/Inari remain owner-excluded.
